content: Rule for the creation of #define symbols in the header file for parameters with the symbolicNameValue set to TRUE The values of EcucParameterDef s with effective configuration class PreCompile and symbol- icNameValue set to TRUE shall be generated into the header file of the declaring module as #define s. The symbol shall be composed of • either  the module implementation prefix ⌊ Mip g of the declaring BSW Module (ac- cording to BswModuleList [13])  or the apiServicePrefix for Complex Driver Modules • followed by the literal "Conf_" followed by • the shortName of the EcucParamConfContainerDef of the declaring module followed by "_" followed by • the shortName of the EcucContainerValue container which holds the sym- bolicNameValue configuration parameter value.
